First, find the derivative f’(x) of the function. Set it equal to zero to find critical points. Solve for x. Then, check the second derivative f''(x) at those points. If f''(x) > 0, it’s a minimum; if < 0, a maximum. If zero, it’s inconclusive. I hate derivatives, but this is how it’s done.
